attribution: GSDP/NSDP: MOSPI / NSO, compiled in RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (Tables 10 and 22, 2011–12 constant prices; Table 8 historical current prices). Child mortality: SRS via RBI Table 4 and SRS Statistical Reports 2021 and 2023; MOSPI Table 2.11 for 1971–2001. Politics: ECI / PRS / official CM lists / Britannica.
comparability: The 2011–2024 income points are annual per-capita NSDP at constant 2011–12 prices (market prices), MOSPI via RBI Handbook Table 10 (29 Aug 2025). 2024–25 is plotted only where that table publishes a figure. The 1981, 1991 and 2001 income points are older current-price factor-cost series and are not spliced to the 2011–12 constant series. IMR is the SRS annual series compiled in RBI Table 4 (11 Dec 2025) for 2004–2023, with 1971–2001 from MOSPI Table 2.11. Under-five mortality is added only for 2021 and 2023, and only for bigger states in the SRS Statistical Reports. State reorganisation in 1956, 2000, 2014 and 2019 breaks longer series: parent-state figures before a split include the child territory; MOSPI’s 2011–12 tables backcast Andhra Pradesh and Telangana separately but do not unsplice 2000. Jammu and Kashmir GSDP from 2019–20 excludes Ladakh. The All-India comparison line is per-capita NNI at 2011–12 prices from the same table, not state NSDP. Where a figure is missing it is omitted.
